# M12-S2 gap: the linker audit reports every third-party chain per sink.
# A standard-library chain (encoding/json reflection) that reaches a sink
# first, or an allowlisted dependency with a shorter chain, must not hide
# another dependency's chain to the same sink; standard-library-only,
# runtime-only, and first-party chains never blame.
# RED expectation: the single shortest chain per sink hides cases A, D, X,
# and E (the build succeeds or prints no warning), blames value-receiver
# methods under a bogus package name in case V, treats a dotless module
# path as standard library in case M, and exempts a dependency generic that
# the main object instantiates in case G.
# The exec fixtures guard their os/exec call behind an argument count the
# test never reaches, so the call stays reachable to the linker and never
# runs.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Case A: dependency reaches reflect.Value.Method while main uses
# encoding/json -> denied, blamed on the dependency only.
cd a/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/ca$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_reflect\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/jdep'' reaches ''reflect\.ValueOf'''
stderr 'example\.com/jdep\.Init\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
stderr 'example\.com/jdep\.layer4\(\)'
stderr 'reflect\.ValueOf\(\)'
stderr 'transitive_reflect|reflect_allowlist'
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''([^e]|e[^x])'
! stderr 'unauthorized_(cgo|exec|net)'
cd ../..

# Case B: encoding/json alone under a deny policy stays clean and runs.
cd b/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cb$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
exec $WORK/bin/cb$GOEXE
stdout '^\{"a":1\}$'
cd ../..

# Case C: ordinary encoding/json plus a dependency that never reaches a
# sink builds under the default policy with no capability diagnostics.
cd c/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cc$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
exec $WORK/bin/cc$GOEXE
stdout '^\{"n":7\}$'
cd ../..

# Case D: a dependency that decodes with encoding/json reaches reflect
# only through the standard library: the default warn policy prints the
# warning for the dependency, while the main package's own encoding/json
# use and the runtime stay unblamed and no exec, net, or cgo error appears.
cd d/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cd$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'WARNING \[capabilities::unauthorized_reflect\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/ddep'' reaches ''reflect\.New'''
stderr 'example\.com/ddep\.Count\(\)'
! stderr 'ERROR'
! stderr 'unauthorized_(cgo|exec|net)'
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''([^e]|e[^x])'
exec $WORK/bin/cd$GOEXE
stdout '^\{"d":1\} 1$'
cd ../..

# Case X: a dependency that reaches os.startProcess through reflection while
# the main package uses encoding/json is denied and blamed on the dependency.
cd x/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/cx$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/xdep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/xdep\.Init\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
stderr 'os\.startProcess\(\) +at .*os/exec_posix\.go:\d+'
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''([^e]|e[^x])'
! stderr 'unauthorized_(cgo|net)'
cd ../..

# Case F: first-party packages under the main module never blame, even
# when they reach exec and reflection through encoding/json.
cd f/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cf$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
exec $WORK/bin/cf$GOEXE
stdout '^\{"f":2\}$'
cd ../..

# Case E: an allowlisted dependency with the shorter chain does not hide a
# second dependency's chain to the same sink.
cd e/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/ce$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/bdep\.Init\(\)'
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'''
! stderr 'adep\.'
cd ../..

# Case V: a value-receiver method of an allowlisted dependency attributes
# to its import path, not to the receiver type.
cd v/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cv$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
exec $WORK/bin/cv$GOEXE
stdout '^run$'
cd ../..

# Case I: the dependency frame nearest the sink takes the blame, so an
# allowlisted caller does not excuse the dependency below it.
cd i/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/ci$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/inner'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/outer\.Init\(\)'
stderr 'example\.com/inner\.Init\(\)'
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''example\.com/outer'''
cd ../..

# Case M: a dependency whose module path has no dot is third-party, not
# standard library: it is blamed by its module path.
cd m/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/cm$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''mylib'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'mylib\.Init\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
stderr 'os\.startProcess\(\) +at .*os/exec_posix\.go:\d+'
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''([^m]|m[^y])'
cd ../..

# Case G: a dependency generic instantiated by the main package is still the
# dependency's code: the instantiation sits in the main object but is blamed
# on the generic's own package.
cd g/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/cg$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/gdep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/gdep\.Each\['
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''([^e]|e[^x])'
cd ../..

# Case T: -trimpath rewrites file names and clears GOROOT for the linker; the
# standard library is still never blamed and a dotless dependency still is.
cd b/main
logos build -trimpath -o $WORK/bin/ct$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
cd ../../m/main
! logos build -trimpath -o $WORK/bin/ctm$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''mylib'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''([^m]|m[^y])'
cd ../..

# Case W (allow leg): the same Init built with everything allowed
# produces a binary; its disassembly proves the direct constructor
# edge is gone. Tool convention follows logos_cap_stdcgo.txt
# (`go tool nm $WORK/bin/...`) with the selector form of
# `go tool objdump -s symbol binary` (src/cmd/cgo/internal/testlogos).
cd w/ok
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cwok$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
go tool objdump -s 'example\.com/wdep\.Init' $WORK/bin/cwok$GOEXE
stdout 'example\.com/wdep\.Init'
! stdout 'ValueOf'
cd ../..

# Case W (deny leg): the same Init, proved inlined with no direct
# ValueOf edge above, still reaches os.startProcess through the
# method lookup, so the linker blames the dependency for exec.
# Reflect stays allowed: transitive ValueOf/New via synthetic paths
# are legitimate and out of scope here; the normative point is an
# inlined constructor plus a Method lookup with no Method sink.
cd w/main
! logos build -a -gcflags=example.com/wdep=-m -o $WORK/bin/cw$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'inlining call to reflect\.ValueOf'
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/wdep'' reaches ''os\.startProcess'''
stderr 'example\.com/wdep\.Init\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
stderr 'os\.startProcess\(\) +at .*os/exec_posix\.go:\d+'
! stderr 'unauthorized_(cgo|net)'
cd ../..

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/jdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/jdep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_reflect = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/jdep"
)

func main() {
	out, err := json.Marshal(map[string]int{"a": 1})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out))
	dep.Init()
}

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/jdep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "reflect"

type Plugin struct{}

func (p *Plugin) Run() string { return "run" }

//go:noinline
func Init() { layer1() }

//go:noinline
func layer1() { layer2() }

//go:noinline
func layer2() { layer3() }

//go:noinline
func layer3() { layer4() }

//go:noinline
func layer4() {
	m := reflect.ValueOf(&Plugin{}).Method(0)
	_ = m.Call(nil)
}

	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ddep"
)

func main() {
	out, err := json.Marshal(map[string]int{"d": 1})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(string(out), dep.Count())
}

-- d/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/ddep

go 1.27

-- d/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "encoding/json"

//go:noinline
func Count() int {
	var m map[string]int
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"x":1}`), &m); err != nil {
		return -1
	}
	return len(m)
}

-- x/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/xdep

go 1.27

-- x/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"os/exec"
	"reflect"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cmd := exec.Command("echo", "hi")
	m := reflect.ValueOf(cmd).MethodByName("Start")
	m.Call(nil)
}

-- f/main/go.mod --
module example.com/fmain

go 1.27

-- f/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_reflect = "deny"
transitive_exec = "deny"

-- f/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fmain/inner"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(inner.Encode(map[string]int{"f": 2}))
}

-- f/main/inner/inner.go --
package inner

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"reflect"
)

//go:noinline
func Encode(v any) string {
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		_ = exec.Command("true").Run()
	}
	if reflect.ValueOf(v).Kind() != reflect.Map {
		return ""
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return string(out)
}

	println("done")

package dep

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

type T struct{}

//go:noinline
func (T) Run() string {
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		_ = exec.Command("true").Run()
	}
	return "run"
}

-- g/dep/dep.go --
package gdep

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

//go:noinline
func Each[T any](xs []T) int {
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		_ = exec.Command("true").Run()
	}
	return len(xs)
}
